_about: 0.2.1 (2 Nov 2026, the owner): HUD 2's side chat size - the 0.2.0 size becomes LARGE, the new default NORMAL is smaller (still above the vanilla chat text). Code: subtitles chat_size.h, [Subtitles] chat_size 0 normal / 1 large. Apply with specpatch.py to part2_data.js and docs/UI_SPEC.json.

rows.label: Side chat size
rows.help: The text size of HUD 2's side chat (the comm feed beside the HUD): Normal is a little larger than the game's own chat text, Large the bigger size of earlier versions.
